description: This PHP class 'SaveJobTitleController' handles the pre-render setup for the job title editing or saving interface in the OrangeHRM system. It prepares a Vue component with relevant properties based on the request attributes, utilizing configuration services for allowed file types and maximum file size.

classes.name: SaveJobTitleController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the setup of Vue components for saving or editing job titles, based on incoming request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares Vue component with appropriate props based on whether an ID is present in the request, configuring the component for editing or creating a job title.
